title: Scarborough Fair
description: A haunting English ballad in the Dorian mode, made world-famous by Simon & Garfunkel. It teaches the modal sound and smooth 3/4 phrasing using only white keys.

arrangements.label: Beginner
arrangements.notes: Full verse melody on white keys only, with one sustained left-hand dyad per bar.
teachingPoints: Phrase 1 and 4 sit in D position (thumb on D4); phrase 2-3 shift up with 2 on A4 and 5 on D5
Bars 11-12: walk down A-G-F-E with fingers 4-3-2-1, then shift the thumb to D4 in bar 13
The B natural in bar 7 is the Dorian colour note: do not flatten it
Bars 14-16: 5-4-3 on G-F-E, then 2-1 on D-C and finish with 2 on D4 (no thumb cross-overs)
Shape each four-bar phrase in one breath, lifting slightly at the dotted half notes
